content: Targeting API 30+ (R+) requires resources.arsc to be stored uncompressed and 4-byte aligned in the installed APK; failing this causes install failure (error 'Targeting R+ requires the resources.arsc of installed APKs to be stored uncompressed and aligned on a 4-byte boundary', code -124). aapt2 typically handles this correctly by default but hand-built zip pipelines must explicitly store resources.arsc uncompressed and run zipalign -p -f -v 4.
